question: How are international postgraduate tuition amounts determined?
reference_answer: Fees depend on your course and commencement year; consult course pages or the fee calculator.
before:
International postgraduate tuition fees for Australian universities are typically set by each institution based on its own costs of providing education. These fees can vary significantly from one institution to another due to differences in location (e.g., cost of living), program offerings, and administrative overheads.

The exact amount can be found on individual university websites or through their respective country's government departments responsible for higher education. For example, Australia has the Department of Education and Training which oversees national funding programs like the Higher Education Contribution Scheme (HECS).

For more detailed information, you should refer directly to the website of the specific university offering your desired degree program. Each institution will provide clear details about its international fee structure, including any additional charges such as accommodation, living expenses, and other associated costs.
after:
The Australian government sets fees based on student need.
Source: https://www.monash.edu/study/international/faqs
